lineage.strategy: Changed from repeating operating-risk evidence to testing whether the new dated investor checkpoint changes execution certainty; it does not yet.

observedWeaknesses.observation: The September 29 forum is a disclosure checkpoint, not operating evidence; previously announced 2027 production/robotaxi and 2028 humanoid targets remain forward-looking.
observedWeaknesses.whyItMatters: Treating conference participation as execution proof would inflate confidence before commercialization evidence exists.

risks.risk: Near-term investor-event visibility can create narrative momentum without changing the underlying execution evidence for forward production and commercialization targets.

falsifiers.condition: The September 29 event or subsequent primary disclosures provide source-addressed quantitative evidence of production conversion, scaled robotaxi economics or materially improved operating performance.

improvementPaths: Anchor future execution confidence to disclosed production conversion, unit economics, utilization and operating results rather than event participation.

unknowns.unknown: Whether the September 29 forum will contain new quantitative commercialization evidence.

recommendation: Use as bounded confidence-inflation/execution-risk support; do not assign Alpha's numeric risk or score.
